subject: SurgeFall incident: bridging credits & trial extension
messages:
From: Marc Sutherland <marc.sutherland@brightcart.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: BrightCart Ops <ops@brightcart.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SurgeFall incident — production batch failures and credit request

Hi Priyom,

We hit a significant disruption during our nightly ingestion window (03:00–04:00 UTC) where a subset of Redwood endpoints experienced elevated latency and a handful of 5xx errors. That batch drives downstream pricing updates; the outage caused delayed price refreshes for ~22% of our customers and triggered manual rollback work from our ops team.

We opened a support ticket (BR-8721) but wanted to escalate to ask for a goodwill credit and an extension of our trial period while we validate stability. Can you confirm what remediation credit Redwood can offer and whether you can extend our trial by 30 days?

I can share logs if that helps — attaching a small timeline export.

Thanks,
Marc
Marc Sutherland
Head of Engineering, BrightCart
marc.sutherland@brightcart.com

Attachment: incident-timeline.csv (CSV, 54 KB)
From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: Marc Sutherland <marc.sutherland@brightcart.com>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 03 Apr 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SurgeFall incident — production batch failures and credit request

Marc — thanks for the heads up and for attaching the timeline. I'm really sorry this hit a critical window for you.

Quick update on our side: our infra team has started a short-lived rollback/patch for the routing policy that likely caused the elevated tail latency. We'll follow up with a full postmortem once the engineers finish the session replay.

For immediate next steps, I propose:
- A provisional 25% service credit (applied to April invoices) while we complete the RCA.
- A 30-day trial extension as you requested so you have a clean window to validate stability with us.

If that sounds acceptable, I'll loop in Sales ops to get formal approval and a sign-off doc prepared (we may need legal if you want it in writing). Can you confirm the preferred billing contact and whether you want the credit applied as a token top-up or invoice credit?

I'll keep you posted; copying Stephanie (sales) and Aditya (acct lead) to get them engaged.

Best,
Priyom Das
Senior Manager, Customer Escalations
Redwood Inference

From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: priyom_das@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 03 Apr 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: SurgeFall incident — provisional credit recommendation

Looping in finance clearance route here. Priyom — 25% provisional credit sounds reasonable as a starting offer; given BrightCart is in proof-of-concept and the impact window hit production pricing, I recommend:

- 25% credit applied as token/top-up (easier operationally)
- 30-day trial extension
- Exec-level note offering a complimentary account review + 1:1 reliability deep-dive with our SRE team

Stephanie — can you confirm the credit SKU and whether we need legal sign-off for a DocuSign addendum? If finance needs a signed approval, I'll route the attached approval-signer.pdf.

— Aditya

Attachment: approval-signer.pdf (PDF, 12 KB)
From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: Marc Sutherland <marc.sutherland@brightcart.com>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 06 Apr 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SurgeFall incident — bridging credits & trial extension

Hi Marc — thanks for your patience.

We've confirmed the following (approved by Sales Ops and Finance):

- A 25% compensatory credit applied as a token top-up (equivalent to $6,250 in token value) will be issued to BrightCart within 3 business days.
- A 30-day trial extension starting from today (new trial end: 2026-05-06).
- A complimentary 60-minute reliability review with our SREs; available slots next week if you'd like to schedule.

Next steps for you: please confirm whether token top-up is acceptable and the billing contact for documentation. If you prefer invoice credit instead, we can do that but it will add an extra 3–5 business days for processing.

I've attached the internal approval document (finance already signed). If you want the DocuSign addendum, say the word and we'll send it.

Thanks again — we value BrightCart and want to make this right.

Best,
Priyom Das
Senior Manager, Customer Escalations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: approval-signer.pdf (PDF, 12 KB)
From: Marc Sutherland <marc.sutherland@brightcart.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: BrightCart Ops <ops@brightcart.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Apr 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SurgeFall incident — bridging credits & trial extension

Priyom — that works for us. Token top-up is preferred so our platform team can immediately resume load testing. Billing contact is: finance@brightcart.com.

Please send the DocuSign if you need a signed addendum; otherwise we'll wait for the token top-up. Also keen on the SRE review — please propose two slots and we'll pick one.

Appreciate the swift handling.

— Marc
